cast.name: Dark Spot Villain
cast.description: small flat brown Dark Spot villain (leading the Dullness and Uneven Tone gang) standing on the woman's cheek; smug, taunting, menacing cartoon-baddie voice

cast.name: KNC Jar
cast.description: talking DERMDOC Kojic Acid night cream jar with cartoon eyes, arms and feet; sassy, cocky, bouncy cartoon voice

cast.name: Kojic Acid
cast.description: golden spiky Kojic Acid ingredient hero leading the KNC Team (with Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin); bright, confident, upbeat heroic cartoon voice

cast.name: Narrator
cast.description: off-screen brand voiceover; warm, clear, polished female ad narrator

lines.speaker: dark_spot
lines.bn: আমাদের ফেড করা তোর কম্ম নয়!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.bn: তাই নাকি? একবার টেস্ট করে দেখবি?
lines.or: ସତରେ? ଥରେ ଟେଷ୍ଟ କରି ଦେଖିବା କି?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Powered by three targeted ingredients in one night cream.
lines.bn: তিনটে টার্গেটেড ইনগ্রেডিয়েন্টের পাওয়ার, একটাই নাইট ক্রিমে।
lines.ta: மூணு டார்கெட்டட் இன்கிரீடியன்ட்ஸ் பவர், ஒரே நைட் க்ரீம்ல.
lines.te: మూడు టార్గెటెడ్ ఇంగ్రీడియెంట్స్ పవర్, ఒకే నైట్ క్రీమ్‌లో.
lines.ml: മൂന്ന് ടാർഗെറ്റഡ് ഇൻഗ്രീഡിയന്റ്സിന്റെ പവർ, ഒരൊറ്റ നൈറ്റ് ക്രീമിൽ.
lines.or: ତିନୋଟି ଟାର୍ଗେଟେଡ୍ ଇନଗ୍ରେଡିଏଣ୍ଟର ପାୱାର, ଗୋଟିଏ ନାଇଟ୍ କ୍ରିମରେ।

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid Night Cream. Every night counts.
lines.bn: ডার্মডক কোজিক অ্যাসিড নাইট ক্রিম। প্রতিটা রাতই দামি!
lines.ta: டெர்ம்டாக் கோஜிக் ஆசிட் நைட் க்ரீம். ஒவ்வொரு நைட்டும் வொர்த்!
lines.te: డెర్మ్‌డాక్ కోజిక్ యాసిడ్ నైట్ క్రీమ్. ప్రతి నైట్ ముఖ్యం!
lines.ml: ഡെർമ്ഡോക് കോജിക് ആസിഡ് നൈറ്റ് ക്രീം. ഓരോ രാത്രിയും മുതലാക്കൂ!
lines.or: ଡର୍ମଡକ କୋଜିକ ଏସିଡ ନାଇଟ କ୍ରିମ। ପ୍ରତି ରାତି ଦାମୀ!

notes: Four voices: Dark Spot villain (f0 ~178 Hz), KNC jar (f0 ~193 Hz), Kojic Acid hero (f0 ~267 Hz), narrator (f0 ~205 Hz). Villain and jar sit close in original pitch, so villain gets -3 st + villain fx and jar +2 st + cartoon fx to keep them clearly apart. Short ref clips: villain speech is 0.0-1.5 s, jar speech only 1.7-2.76 s and Kojic speech only 4.4-5.6 s; their ref_ranges are padded into the adjacent silence (jar to 3.3 s, Kojic 4.3-5.9 s) to reach the 1.5 s minimum, so the actual voiced audio inside them is ~1.1-1.2 s. Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin do not speak. Video is 17.02 s (prompt planned 20 s); the 'Before / After 2 weeks' section has no dialogue. KNC kept as spelled-out letters. Text pass (client feedback EDL): L5 says the full product name instead of 'KNC' plus a shorter tagline; dubs say 'DERMDOC Kojic Acid Night Cream' (no 'two percent') to fit the 2.94 s slot with the tagline.
